Acceptance 3: cooperative and forced Stop settle, retain native uncertainty and skipped calls, permit next command
Acceptance 4: real headerless React edit/build/preview/exit/failed-build/repair/render cycle and current mode capabilities
Acceptance 5: stopResident retains acknowledged files, clears replay, shares overlap rejection; restart still replays before exit
Acceptance 6: packed public agent/SDK imports execute fixed Vite snapshot cycle without runtime registry acquisition
Parity 1: SDK completion, output bytes, effects, Worker state and fresh invocation cwd/env survive adapter
Parity 2: SDK file-policy failure facts retained; ordinary read-transform-write makes no CAS or rollback claim
Provider torn state after write: explicit provider error, retained write/results
Command cancellation: cooperative settlement, skipped call error and next command
Forced Stop peer loss: physical Worker replacement, unknown effects, no replay
File/shell corrupt policy input: denied operation leaves protected files unchanged
Host mode sibling drift: changed tools/prompt; stale project calls rejected by owner
Replacement torn state/overlap: existing restart report/recovery owner, one replacement generation, cleared resident replay
